# Which in / out calls depend on an encoding mismatch? (Oct 24, 2026 data, generated by tools/sensitivity.js; full detail in SENSITIVITY.json)

Mismatches are from the Analyst's RULES_CHECK.md: ACC chain pairing; Mountain West pool, restart vs continue, ineligible removed first; Sun Belt ineligible champion; Big Ten Section B for second; American 10.6 restart; no ineligibility flags in the data (ACC, MW, Sun Belt, Big Ten, American).

Method: each call is re-run on the unchanged engine under (1) h2h_only: every step after head-to-head replaced by a draw among all still-tied teams (covers any ranking, rating, composite, coin toss and any rewrite of later steps: pool, restart, chain), (2) both readings (Pac-12, Conference USA; ACC equal-games reading), (3) restart/continue flipped, plus (4) a counting proof that uses no tiebreaker (total wins) and how many extra rivals could be ineligible before it stops holding.

Ineligibility: YES, hypothetically: proof holds with 0 extra ineligible rivals, so one other Big Ten team being ruled ineligible would reopen it (no ineligibility data exists; no known case). Also rests on the 2024 text being the 2026 policy only for the top-two format, not for any tiebreak. |
